verdict.rationale: The OCR model page lists a Batching /v1/batch endpoint, and a community tester mentions batched pricing, so an async bulk path exists. However, the pack has no documented rate limits or throughput guarantees. One hands-on report says a 900-page synchronous API submission timed out and had to be split into chunks. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, throughput or SLA figures for million-page workloads, detailed batch-job docs (job sizes, retries, completion times), independent evidence of high-volume batch runs.
